name: BN6's Beast Out counter
why: His battle NaviStats' +0x21 is BN6's BeastOutCounter, 3 as a battle copies his NaviStats from the PET's, one less each Beast Out turn; BN5 has no Beast Out, and its +0x21 holds its save's 1. Neither is read in a battle without Beast Out (the spec's): no part of MegaMan's battle logic here.
evidence: BN6: the counter decremented and written back by 0x08015A38 (its NaviStats setter at 0x08015A78), read as Beast Out ends by 0x080159C6 (0x080159E4), by 0x08013892 and 0x08013DA0 (getters with r1 0x21 at 0x080138F4, 0x08013DB6)
BN5: its only getter naming +0x21 is at 0x0801292A; 1 in every BN5 trace from t1, 3 in every BN6 trace
